System Overview

Intelligent Market Surveillance

The Cryptocurrency Market Data Analysis Bot is a fully automated operational intelligence system engineered to continuously monitor live cryptocurrency market data, extract structured pricing intelligence, and execute threshold-based decision workflows — without manual intervention.

Built on UiPath Studio, the system navigates to CoinMarketCap, captures Bitcoin's live price via OCR-based screen extraction, converts raw image data into structured numerical values, and evaluates them against configurable buy/sell thresholds.

Upon signal detection, the bot compiles analytical data into Excel reporting tables and dispatches automated email alerts — creating a closed-loop surveillance and reporting pipeline that mirrors enterprise-grade financial monitoring infrastructure.

Operational Architecture

Workflow Pipeline

A cinematic view of the end-to-end automation sequence — from live market access to intelligent reporting delivery.

STEP · 01
Market Website Access
UiPath opens a browser session and navigates to CoinMarketCap's Bitcoin page — the authoritative source for real-time cryptocurrency pricing.
STEP · 02
Live Price Extraction
A targeted Get Text activity captures the current BTC/USD price element directly from the live DOM, converting the displayed value into a raw string variable.
STEP · 03
OCR Image Processing
Screenshot capture paired with OCR processing converts the visual price representation into machine-readable text — enabling structured data pipelines from visual market interfaces.
STEP · 04
Structured Data Conversion
Assign activities sanitize the extracted string — stripping currency symbols and formatting characters — and cast the value to a numerical double for computational processing.
STEP · 05
Threshold Logic Evaluation
An If-Else decision tree compares the live price against configurable Buy (≤$60,000) and Sell (≥$70,000) thresholds, determining the appropriate market action signal.
STEP · 06
Intelligent Notification Dispatch
Upon signal detection, a Message Box alert and Send SMTP Email activity trigger in sequence — delivering real-time "Crypto Alert" notifications with the detected action and price data.
STEP · 07
Automated Reporting & Logging
Build Data Table, Add Data Row, and Write Range Workbook activities compile the timestamped price data, action taken, and execution status into CryptoData.xlsx for persistent analytical reporting.
